footer.tagline:
Not a journey to become someone new.
A journey back to yourself.

home.meet_p1: Reflecting Journeys is born from more than twenty years of global experience — as a coach, entrepreneur, consultant and humanitarian worker across projects in psychosocial support, education, peacebuilding and conflict resolution.
home.meet_p2: Originally from Italy and now anchored in Beirut, Laura weaves together Western education and Eastern philosophy into one integrative practice. As a **Reflector** in Human Design — the rarest type, just 1% of people — she becomes your mirror, reflecting your own energy back to you with clarity and compassion.
home.why_p1: Energy therapy helps you reconnect with yourself beneath stress, conditioning, emotional overwhelm, survival mode and self-protective patterns.

services.coaching_desc: Deep introspection that connects mind, body and emotions — so you stop running on autopilot and start living from alignment.
services.human_design_desc: Your unique energetic blueprint — a practical map of how you're designed to make decisions and use your energy.
services.reiki_desc: Gentle Japanese energy work to release tension, rebalance your centres and let your body regenerate.
services.coaching_lead: A deeper kind of coaching — where mind and body meet, and life begins to unfold in ways you couldn't have consciously planned.
services.human_design_lead: A unique energetic blueprint — like a fingerprint or a genetic code, entirely your own.
services.reiki_lead: Energy moves. Sometimes it gets stuck — from stress, emotion, exhaustion. Reiki helps it flow again.

about.lead: More than twenty years of global experience — woven into one cohesive practice that bridges mind, body and energy.
about.story_p1: For over two decades I have lived and worked as a coach, entrepreneur, consultant and humanitarian worker across the globe — on projects in psychosocial support, education, peacebuilding and conflict resolution.
about.story_p2: Originally from Italy, my anchor is now Beirut. Living here has taught me, in the most visceral way, that resilience isn't about being unbreakable — it's about the light that comes through the cracks. This is the core truth I bring into my work.
about.story_p3: My education reflects a global path: studies in Italy and the United Kingdom, professional certifications in the United States and Malaysia, and teachings drawn from Indian and Japanese wisdom traditions.
about.story_p4: This synthesis of **Western education and Eastern philosophy** forms the backbone of my integrative practice — a space where clients feel truly seen, safe, and empowered to embrace every part of their story, especially the fractured ones.

cta.title: Ready to come back to yourself?
cta.lead:
The first step is a free 30-minute discovery call.

A relaxed conversation to explore where you are and the support you're looking for.

testimonials.quote: Laura guided me and helped me almost without me noticing it; her way is gentle and sensitive. She asked the right questions, gave me the time and the space to develop my thoughts, and made me feel safe and empowered. She opened my eyes to things that were already right in front of me. Now, I feel I'm living another life — with the tools and the capability to continue my growth on my own.

Working with Laura has been an eye-opening and soul-refreshing experience. She is an incredible healer who helped me dive deep into my emotional and energetic blocks. Her coaching unravels the inner self layer by layer, uncovering answers that were always there but never quite so clear. By integrating Reiki, she provides a unique look at how your energy handles outside stressors. I've come away with a much deeper understanding of myself.
